verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-3 approval remains supported. The record is findings-only and accurately identifies the inert premium gate, the model/window coupling that makes a direct `opus5` addition unsafe, and the existing machine-park starvation terminal. Its proposed staged approach keeps observation separate from admission, then specifies the durable state needed to distinguish never-observed accounts, live shape drift, and probe outages. The load-bearing transitions and consumer rules are internally consistent: received malformed responses advance `last_probed`, true observation outages do not, freshness keys only on `last_probed`, and durable state cannot refuse without a live missing-window signal. The named mutation obligations cover the gate, retry state, TTL behavior, live-window override, malformed records, parking target, and YAML execution seam. No blocker, major, or other actionable diff-scoped issue is supported. Progress is stagnant because the prior round also had no findings; this is continued correctness, not a regression.
